Title: Desktop collector shell and sign-in
Description: As a desktop user, I want to authenticate to Cortexa and configure my local knowledge extraction so that I can start collecting. The WPF desktop app initializes with a Generic Host, appsettings options, Windows Credential Manager store for secrets, SQLite cache, a settings screen, and Cortexa sign-in with JWT token refresh.
AcceptanceCriteria: WPF projects src/Collector.Application, src/Collector.Infrastructure, src/Collector.Presentation (net10.0-windows) and tests/Collector.Tests are added to the US122 solution; Clean Architecture references (Domain <- Application <- Infrastructure; Presentation -> Application + Infrastructure)
dotnet build -warnaserror and dotnet test pass from Cortexa-dev/desktop/collector
Project CLAUDE.md claude-config gains a desktop entry (build, test, format, lint, audit run from desktop/collector); this config edit is the only allowed change outside the folder
WPF application shell is responsive and displays main screens
Generic Host dependency injection container is initialized
appsettings.json and appsettings.local.json configuration is loaded
Windows Credential Manager securely stores AI keys and Cortexa token
SQLite local cache is initialized with correct schema
Settings screen allows configuration of API keys, gateway URL and collector server URL
Cortexa sign-in screen uses the gateway POST /auth/login endpoint
JWT token refresh is automatic via POST /auth/refresh
All code for this story lives inside Cortexa-dev/desktop/collector; nothing in services/, contracts/, frontend/ or deploy/ is edited or referenced (outside logic is re-implemented inside)
TalkingPoints: Building the WPF desktop app shell with Generic Host, config management, Credential Manager integration for secrets, SQLite caching, settings screen, and Cortexa authentication with JWT refresh. The app is production-ready with clean dependency injection.

Tasks.Title: Add WPF projects to the collector solution
Tasks.Description: Add the desktop Application, Infrastructure, Presentation and test projects to Collector.sln from US122; wire references; add the desktop entry to project CLAUDE.md claude-config.

Tasks.Title: Set up WPF application and Generic Host
Tasks.Description: Create WPF MainWindow, initialize Generic Host, register services, set up app.xaml and app.xaml.cs.

Tasks.Title: Configure appsettings and dependency injection
Tasks.Description: Load appsettings.json and appsettings.local.json; register options and services via HostApplicationBuilder.

Tasks.Title: Implement Windows Credential Manager store
Tasks.Description: Create secure credential storage using System.Net.CredentialCache and Windows DPAPI for AI keys and tokens.

Tasks.Title: Initialize SQLite local cache
Tasks.Description: Set up Microsoft.Data.Sqlite database with schema for documents, units, and batch status.

Tasks.Title: Build settings screen and Cortexa sign-in
Tasks.Description: Create UI for API keys, gateway URL, collector server URL and sign-in form. Integrate gateway POST /auth/login and /auth/refresh.

Tasks.Title: Implement token refresh mechanism
Tasks.Description: Auto-refresh JWT before expiry; handle 401 responses by prompting re-login.
